title: llm-usage-metrics session report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for session report --json output (session rows, repo rows with --by-repo, or one session's timeline with --timeline).

rowCount.description: Session or repo rows before --top; absent with --timeline.

oneOf.description: Session or repo rows in render order.

source.description: Source id the session came from.

repoRoot.description: The session's project: the directory it started in; omitted when unknown.

firstActivity.description: ISO timestamp of the session's first event.

lastActivity.description: ISO timestamp of the session's last event.

durationMs.description: Raw span in milliseconds: lastActivity minus firstActivity.

activeMs.description: Gap-capped active time in milliseconds: sum of inter-event gaps, each capped at 5 minutes; 0 for single-event sessions.

eventCount.description: Number of usage events in the session.

models.description: Model identifiers active in the session.

costExplicitUsd.description: Part of costUsd the source logged (costMode explicit); omitted when none does.

costEstimatedUsd.description: Part of costUsd priced from tokens (costMode estimated); omitted when none is.

filePaths.description: Absolute paths of the local session files this run counted whose stored usage carries the session id, whatever its date, departed files included; from the event store, so omitted when the store is off or holds no such file (a file it could not fingerprint is left out).

toolCalls.description: Tool calls the session made in the window, deduplicated as the tools report counts them; omitted for sources that log no tool calls (only claude, codex and pi do) and for a source whose files, or another machine's cache, could not be read.

toolErrors.description: Of toolCalls, those whose result records an error; present with toolCalls.

repoRoot.description: The project: the directory its sessions started in; omitted for the unattributed bucket.

sessionCount.description: Number of sessions attributed to the repository.

firstActivity.description: ISO timestamp of the repository's first event.

lastActivity.description: ISO timestamp of the repository's last event.

sources.description: Source ids active in the repository.

timeline.description: --timeline: the one session --id matched and its rows in time order.

rows.description: Usage, tool_call and message rows in time order; at one timestamp, usage first, then messages, then tool calls.

timelineUsageRow.description: One usage record of the session, with the running cost.

model.description: Model identifier; omitted when the source does not log one.

costUsd.description: Resolved cost in USD; omitted when no pricing resolved.

runningCostUsd.description: Summed cost of this and every earlier priced request; omitted while none is priced.

runningCostIncomplete.description: True when this or an earlier request has no resolved price.

timelineToolCallRow.description: One tool call, read live from the session file.

name.description: Tool name as the source logs it.

status.description: How the call ended; unknown when the file has no result for it.

timelineMessageRow.description: One message, read live from the session file; its text is never included.
